title: fix(plugin-auth)!: impersonation, SSO-provider administration and the admin plugin's role-scalar actions refuse a held caller (ADR-0069 D3)
body:
Fixes #23335
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

## What changes

ADR-0069 D3 gates a held session (an expired or administrator-forced password, enforced MFA not yet enrolled) out of every protected resource until it remediates. REST, the runtime dispatcher and the platform-admin raw mounts (`judgePlatformAdmin`, PR #23360) already refuse one. The doors better-auth serves itself never did: their session is a raw better-auth read that `customSession` never decorates, and no ADR-0069 transport seam sees a request under the auth namespace. This PR closes the card's remaining leg.

Each door now asks the session gate's own posture carrier for the acting user, in the organization their session operates in: `AuthManager.computeAuthGate`, the first entry of `IAuthService.resolveUserAuthGates` (#23287's one per-user posture computation, PR #23440). It then refuses a held caller with `judgeHeldSession`, the held refusal `judgePlatformAdmin` already gives (factored out of it, byte-identical). No new gate, no second posture computation, no new error code.

### Doors and verdicts (security card)

| door | served by | a held caller before (measured, every held state) | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST /admin/impersonate-user` | better-auth endpoint rebuilt by `applyPlatformAdminImpersonation` | platform admin: **200**, a session minted as the target, and that session is not held, so the hold was bypassed outright | **403** with the posture code, no session minted |
| `POST /sso/register` | `@better-auth/sso`, authorized by the global before-hook | platform admin: **200**, the provider row landed | **403** with the posture code, no row |
| `POST /sso/update-provider`, `POST /sso/delete-provider` | `@better-auth/sso` (provider owner) | owning platform admin: **200**, issuer rewritten to another host / row deleted | **403** with the posture code, provider unchanged |
| `set-role`, `get-user`, `update-user`, `list-users`, `list-user-sessions`, `revoke-user-session`, `revoke-user-sessions` (all under `/admin/`) | better-auth `admin` plugin, authorized on the legacy `role` scalar | caller carrying `role = 'admin'`: **200** on every one, `update-user` landed | **403** with the posture code, the write never lands |

The refusal, measured on the boot: `403 {"success":false,"error":{"code":"MFA_REQUIRED","message":"Multi-factor authentication is required. Please set up an authenticator app to continue."}}`, the same `code` and `message` (the remediation pointer) the session gate gives on a data read and the same body `judgePlatformAdmin` gives on the raw platform-admin mounts.

### Posture to verdict (H1, measured)

| posture held | scope (ruling C′ item 1) | session gate on a non-allow-listed route (data read) | these doors |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PASSWORD_EXPIRED` | credential | 403 `PASSWORD_EXPIRED` | 403 `PASSWORD_EXPIRED` |
| `PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED` | credential | 403 `PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED` | 403 `PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED` |
| `MFA_REQUIRED` (global floor) | account | 403 `MFA_REQUIRED` | 403 `MFA_REQUIRED` |
| `MFA_REQUIRED` (only the session's organization requires it) | account | 403 `MFA_REQUIRED` | 403 `MFA_REQUIRED` |
| none, or the posture lookup failed | none | 200 | admitted, unchanged |

Source of that verdict: the session gate holds every scope. `computeAuthGate` puts the first entry of `resolveUserAuthGates` on `user.authGate` ("Every scope holds a session, because a session IS the password sign-in"), and `evaluateAuthGate` refuses whatever posture that carrier holds, without reading its scope. The API-key seam's `account`-only rule is not reused here: a key is not a session, and these doors are session doors.

### What an attacker who holds only a held administrator's password can no longer reach

- Mint a session as any non-admin user (impersonation), which previously bypassed the hold outright because the minted session is not held.
- Register an identity provider, or rewrite the issuer and endpoints of one the administrator owns, or delete it: login routing for the environment.
- Through a legacy `role = 'admin'` scalar: list and read users, list and revoke their sessions, update users, set roles.

Still reachable for a held caller, on purpose: sign-in, change-password, two-factor enrollment, sign-out (remediation, unchanged); `/admin/stop-impersonating` (the exit from an impersonation, carried by the impersonated session); `/admin/has-permission` (a question that refuses no one).

## How each door asks (H2, H3, H5)

- **H2, where the posture comes from (measured).** With a probe line in the impersonation handler (built into dist, then removed), the caller `adminMiddleware` hands the endpoint carried no `authGate` in 15 of 15 calls (five states, three actors), and no `isPlatformAdmin` either: it is the raw `sys_user` row. `GET /auth/get-session` on the same session did carry `authGate`. So every door asks; none reads the request.
- **The ask.** Impersonation: an injected `SessionPostureOracle`, wired in `auth-manager.ts` to `computeAuthGate(userId, organizationId)`, asked at the start of the handler with `ctx.context.session.session.activeOrganizationId`. SSO and the role-scalar actions: the global before-hook resolves the actor (`resolveActor`, user id and active organization) and calls `assertActorNotHeld`, which asks the same `computeAuthGate`. The role-scalar and SSO update/delete branches skip the session read when no gate feature is active (`isAuthGateActive`, the same caches the computation reads), as the transport seams do.
- **H3, the refusal.** `judgeHeldSession(sessionUser)` (`platform-admin-gate.ts`) is `evaluateAuthGate(sessionUser, '')` plus the judge's envelope; `judgePlatformAdmin` now calls it. Inside better-auth it is thrown as `APIError('FORBIDDEN', record)` with that record, so the vendor lane answers the gate's nested envelope, not its own flat one. The codes are the closed `AuthGateCodeSchema` vocabulary.
- **Order.** Identity (the vendor's 401) first, then the posture, then authorization, as the session gate and the judge apply it. A held signed-in caller who is not an administrator now reads the posture code instead of the vendor's `403 YOU_ARE_NOT_ALLOWED_*` (same status). Pinned at the impersonation door.
- **H5, organization.** The organization passed is the one the session operates in. Pinned: with only the organization's `require_mfa` set, `resolveUserAuthGates(admin, { organizationId })` answers `[MFA_REQUIRED]` and `resolveUserAuthGates(admin, {})` answers `[]`, and impersonation, registration and a role-scalar write are refused `MFA_REQUIRED`.
- **Fail-open.** A posture read that fails answers `[]` (the computation's own contract), so the door admits, exactly as the session gate does. Pinned on the boot with the posture read failing.

## Measured first (H4: the role-scalar vendor actions)

Real boot (`@objectstack/verify` `bootStack`, `OS_SCIM_ENABLED` for the `admin` plugin, `OS_SSO_ENABLED`), before the fix (plugin-auth built from `f9b421716`), a signed-up member carrying `sys_user.role = 'admin'`:

| action | unheld | PASSWORD_EXPIRED | MFA_REQUIRED | PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED | MFA by organization |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `list-users`, `get-user`, `list-user-sessions` | 200 | 200 | 200 | 200 | 200 |
| `update-user` (the name changed) | 200 | 200 | 200 | 200 | 200 |
| `set-role`, `revoke-user-sessions`, `revoke-user-session` | 200 | 200 | 200 | 200 | 200 |
| protected data read (control) | 200 | 403 | 403 | 403 | 403 |

The ADR-0068 platform admin (no scalar) is refused there by the vendor with `403 YOU_ARE_NOT_ALLOWED_*`, held or not. So the held-caller check applies to these seven actions, as the dispatch's surface rule names. `VENDOR_ROLE_SCALAR_ADMIN_PATHS` (`admin-impersonate-endpoint.ts`) holds them, and a unit pin classifies every route the installed `admin` plugin registers (held here; impersonation's own door; a raw mount that runs `judgePlatformAdmin` first; the exit; the question), so a vendor route nobody decided for turns red.

## Tests

Final head `14edf8922` unless stated.

- New booted pin, `packages/verify/src/held-session-vendor-admin-doors.pin.test.ts`, 28 cases:
  - unheld controls: impersonation 200 with one session minted, registration 200 with the row landed, owner issuer rewrite 200 with the row changed, scalar `update-user` 200 with the name changed;
  - per held state (`PASSWORD_EXPIRED`, `MFA_REQUIRED`, `PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED`), six cases each: impersonation 403 with the code and no session minted; registration 403 and no row; owner rewrite and delete 403 and the provider unchanged; scalar `update-user` 403 and the name unchanged; all seven role-scalar actions 403 with the code; a held non-admin at impersonation reads the posture code;
  - organization-only MFA: the computation reads `[MFA_REQUIRED]` with the organization and `[]` without; impersonation, registration and scalar `update-user` refused;
  - fail-open: with the posture read failing, the computation answers `[]`, the data read is 200 and impersonation is 200.
  - With the existing `held-session-platform-admin.pin.test.ts`: `Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 41 passed (41)`.
- New unit pin, `admin-impersonate-endpoint.held-caller.test.ts` (4 cases: every installed `admin` plugin path classified exactly once, no stale entry, the held set, every mount-judged path really opens with `gateAdmin`). `platform-admin-gate.held-session.test.ts` gains 5 cases for `judgeHeldSession`, including the byte-identity with the judge. Targeted plugin-auth run (9 files, `auth-manager.test.ts` included): `Tests 426 passed (426)`.
- **Ablation, the impersonation door's check** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, blob `4e2afe618` to `67beda690`; plugin-auth rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present in `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.mjs`): the booted pin went `7 failed | 21 passed (28)`, exactly the seven impersonation cases (three held states, the three held non-admin cases, the organization case). Registration, the SSO owner doors, the role-scalar actions, the controls and fail-open stayed green. Restore: blob equals HEAD `4e2afe618`, `git diff HEAD` empty, plugin-auth rebuilt, preflight `--absent` green with the whole tree clean, pins `41 passed (41)`.
- `@objectstack/plugin-auth` full suite at `beebec8f3` (the head before a refactor that only binds the refusal record to a local name), 4 shards: 36 + 35 + 35 + 35 files, 779 + 928 (10 skipped) + 520 + 597 = 2824 passed.
- `@objectstack/verify` full suite at `beebec8f3`, 3 shards: 40 files, 107 + 126 + 114 = 347 passed.
- Typecheck (`tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck`): plugin-auth exit 0 at `14edf8922`; verify exit 0 at `beebec8f3`.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the 6 changed `.ts` files: 0 errors, 0 warnings. The repo-wide lint run is CI's.

## Gates

- Derived at `14edf8922`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` names 68 families for this diff (the PM's lead listed 50 at `ad5a7d7c3`).
- All 68 run locally at `14edf8922`, each exit code captured before any pipe: 68 of 68 exit 0. The two dist-reading families first needed state: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3, missing dist) until a full workspace build (turbo, 76 tasks, exit 0); `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` found the `held.body` record (see Acceptance notes), fixed in `14edf8922`.
- Reconciliation: `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reports `68 derived, 68 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.
- Changeset gates: `check:adr-0087-registration` reads `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` on `.changeset/23335-held-admin-vendor-doors-refused.md` (BREAKING, bang, clause-② narrowing); `check:changeset-no-major` and `check:empty-changeset` exit 0.
- Families CI owns (lint, the artifact roster, the type-check lanes) are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.

## Acceptance notes

- **In-place fix under the bounded exemption: SSO `update-provider` and `delete-provider`.** Measured on the boot at `ad8dee166` (registration already fixed there): a held (`MFA_REQUIRED`) platform admin who owned a provider rewrote its issuer to another host (200, landed) and deleted another (200, row gone). Same defect class as the registration door, fixed with the same mechanical branch in the same file, pinned in the same file and covered by the same gate families. The claim's file surface named the registration hook only; the seat may record the widening.
- `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` first read `APIError('FORBIDDEN', held.body)` as a member of an imported code table and reported it unresolved. The record is the judge's own object literal, whose `code` comes from the closed posture vocabulary, so it is now bound to a local name and handed over (`14edf8922`, no behaviour change).
- **New export:** `judgeHeldSession` from `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, via the package's `export *` of `platform-admin-gate.ts`. No new error code.
- Not changed, and reads only: a held provider owner still gets `GET /sso/get-provider` and `GET /sso/providers` (sanitized provider details; measured 200). The vendor's `/sso/request-domain-verification` and `/sso/verify-domain` were not measured (domain verification is off in this boot); their `/admin/sso/*` bridges are judged.
- `/admin/oauth2/*` (the oauth-provider plugin) is `SERVER_ONLY` in the installed 1.7.3 (read from source), so it is no HTTP door.
- The booted pins live in `packages/verify`, beside #23360's, because plugin-auth cannot depend on verify. The organization-only case primes `_orgMfaCache` as the background refresh would, the precedent `auth-manager.test.ts` uses.
